title: 第一卷 第25章 你们眼睛瞎了第一卷 第26章 驻颜第一蓝莹草
slug: 失踪十年小师妹让全宗门跪下迎接
content_zh:
雷子越急切道：“可是你这样我不放心。”
他又抬头怒斥洛还真：“洛还真，你真的好恶毒，竟然敢伙同妖兽虐杀同门！此事我回宗一定上禀，届时押你去伏罪台受罚！”
洛还真已经不想车轱辘话来回解释是他的亲亲师妹一直在碰瓷自己了。
雷子越被苏明月下了降头。
大脑完全不运作，自己说什么他都不会听，也不会相信。
至于伙同妖兽？
洛还真扭头看看玄鳞蟒，反应慢半拍问道：“我们现在是朋友了吗？”
玄鳞蟒扭了扭尾巴，羞涩地蹭蹭洛还真。
它没有同类，平日里也没有生物接近自己，一直都是孤零零一条蟒待在这些温泉池底睡大觉。
已经很久没有这么开心地玩耍了。
洛还真一脸开心道：“既然是本尊朋友，那本尊就不揍你啦！待会本尊的师侄们要来跑温泉，你不可吓到他们。”
玄鳞蟒将巨头匍匐下来，做出一副“我乖乖的”的模样。
这娃娃连灵力都没使用，一脚便可爆发出和自己尾巴差不多的力量，它自然明白面前这小祖宗不是自己能惹得起的角色。
一人一蟒在那互动，完全不理雷子越，雷子越更生气了。
以前都是洛还真黏着自己，这段时间自己无视她也是想让她反思知道自己错了。
没想到自己现在愿意主动跟她说话，她反而还将他当透明人！
他咬牙狞声道：“洛还真，你到底有没有听我说话！”
就在这时，身后传来嘈杂的脚步声，紧接着一道道此起彼伏的吸气声和惊呼响起：
“靠！好大一条妖蟒！”
“至少元婴期境界！跑……不对，小师叔在它旁边。”

“……呃，那两块黑乎乎的泥人是谁？”
“好像是……雷师兄和苏师妹？”
负责去灵药园扫荡的弟子们陆陆续续来了。
场面有点诡异，众弟子一时间没有动作，站在入口位置群脸懵逼地望着这一幕。
“你们来得正好！”雷子越抱着浑身挂满血和泥的苏明月，指着洛还真对众人高声道：“这就是你们的好领队，好小师叔！她勾结妖物，意图在秘境中残杀同门！”
众人愣了很久，然后才动。
他们挠头的挠头，扣屁股的扣屁股，然后互相对视，似乎很是疑惑不解的样子。
“哪儿有同门？这里不就小师叔一个人吗？”
“是啊。我没看见什么同门啊也没看见什么大蟒……哎也不知道雷师兄和苏师妹去哪里了。要是他们别那么矫情和自私，听小师叔的话一起走，现在也能来苍华殿养灵池泡泡了。”
“可不是嘛……”
“快别浪费时间了，脱衣服进去吧，累坏了。”
“有道理有道理！”
众人像是想起来什么似的拍拍自己脑瓜子，然后快速脱衣，扑通扑通下饺子似的一个一个跳进冒着腾腾热气的温泉中。
雷子越懵了。
“不是，你们眼睛瞎了吗？！”
content_en:
Lei Ziyue said anxiously: "But I don't trust you like this."
He raised his head again and scolded Luo Huanzhen angrily: "Luo Huanzhen, you are so vicious, you actually dare to collaborate with monsters to kill your fellow disciples! I will definitely report this to the clan when I return to my clan, and I will take you to the stand to be punished!"
Luo Huan really didn't want Che Zhulun to explain back and forth that it was his dear junior sister who had been touching him.
Lei Ziyue was lowered by Su Mingyue.
His brain is not functioning at all, and he will neither listen nor believe what he says.
As for collaborating with monsters?
Luo Huanzhen turned his head to look at the Black Scale Python, and asked slowly, "Are we friends now?"
The black-scaled python twisted its tail and nuzzled Luo Huanzhen shyly.
It has no similar kind, and no creature comes close to it on weekdays. It is always a solitary python sleeping at the bottom of these hot spring pools.
It's been a long time since I had such fun.
Luo Huanzhen said happily: "Since you are my friend, I won't beat you up! My nephews will come to the hot spring later, so you can't scare them."
The black-scaled python crawled down the giant and made a "I'm good" look.
This doll didn't even use its spiritual power. With one kick, it could explode with power similar to its own tail. It naturally understood that the little ancestor in front of it was not a character it could afford.
One person and one python interacted there, completely ignoring Lei Ziyue, which made Lei Ziyue even angrier.
In the past, Luo Huanzhen was always clinging to her. During this time, he ignored her because he wanted her to reflect and realize that she was wrong.
Unexpectedly, now that he is willing to take the initiative to talk to her, she will treat him as a transparent person!
He gritted his teeth and said ferociously: "Luo Huanzhen, did you listen to me?"
At this moment, noisy footsteps came from behind, followed by a series of inhalations and exclamations:
"Damn! What a big monster python!"
"At least it's at the Nascent Soul stage! Run... No, my junior uncle is right next to it."
"...Uh, who are those two black clay figures?"
"It seems...Senior Brother Lei and Junior Sister Su?"
The disciples responsible for cleaning up the elixir garden came one after another.
The scene was a bit strange. The disciples did not move for a while, standing at the entrance looking at this scene with confused faces.
"You came just in time!" Lei Ziyue hugged Su Mingyue, who was covered in blood and mud, pointed at Luo Huanzhen and shouted to everyone: "This is your good leader, your good little uncle! She colludes with monsters and intends to kill her fellow disciples in the secret realm!"
Everyone was stunned for a long time before moving.
They scratched their heads, licked their butts, and then looked at each other, seemingly puzzled.
"Where are the classmates? Isn't my junior uncle the only one here?"
"That's right. I didn't see any classmates or any big python... I don't know where Senior Brother Lei and Junior Sister Su went. If they wouldn't be so pretentious and selfish and listened to Junior Uncle's words and left together, they would be able to come to Canghua Hall to take a dip in the Soul-nurturing Pond now."
"Isn't that right..."
"Stop wasting time, take off your clothes and go in, I'm exhausted."
"It makes sense!"
Everyone patted their heads as if they had remembered something, then quickly took off their clothes, plopped down their dumplings, and jumped into the steaming hot spring one by one.
Lei Zi became more and more confused.
"No, are you blind?!"
